headline: Make email marketing less of a headache.
body: Inside, you'll find 21 short, practical email marketing tactics you can apply one at a time to make your emails work harder.
caption: Email marketing can feel like a big task, especially when you're running your own show. But what if you could make small, practical changes that actually make a difference? Our free guide, '21 Email Marketing Hacks,' gives you exactly that: 21 simple tactics you can try whenever you're ready.
